name: Bhiwadi
pointBasis: Exact immutable WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement locator; not a municipal boundary or parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Bhiwadi Integrated Development Authority (BIDA), Government of Rajasthan, is a local development authority with Bhiwadi headquarters and public land/plot services. Rajasthan's official Urban GIS Portal exposes Khasra and plot map functions and identifies settlement boundaries as a source. These establish local/state custodians, but not a verified anonymous citywide parcel vector response.

runtimeAssessment.reason: The current Urban GIS JavaScript/configuration points to a Rajasthan ArcGIS Settlement_JDA Khasra layer, but anonymous metadata and exact-point query requests to the configured service timed out. No stable native parcel identity plus full polygon was verified.

requests.summary: Current Rajasthan Urban GIS Portal HTML retrieved. It advertises Khasra and plot search/map tools and states that settlement/village boundaries are for viewing only; no parcel feature payload was returned in the HTML.

Current viewer configuration retrieved. It identifies a Khasra FeatureLayer at https://gisprod.rajasthan.gov.in/geocode/rest/services/JDA/Settlement_JDA/MapServer/0 and a JDA plot layer; this is a viewer configuration observation, not proof of Bhiwadi coverage.

Current viewer JavaScript retrieved. It queries FeatureLayers with returnGeometry=true and outFields=*, but its configured Khasra layer is the Jaipur/JDA service and no safe Bhiwadi-specific adapter or schema was established.
Anonymous layer metadata request did not complete. No TLS bypass, login, CAPTCHA bypass or token use.
Bounded exact WUP point query with returnGeometry=true, outFields=* and outSR=4326 did not complete. This is not treated as an exact-point miss or evidence of absence.
Official Bhu-Naksha page did not complete by direct anonymous GET; no retry or TLS exception.
BIDA identifies itself as the Government of Rajasthan authority headquartered at Bhiwadi and lists plot/lease, mutation and property-ID services. No owner or property-record lookup was submitted.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: BIDA local authority pages, Rajasthan Urban GIS Portal, Rajasthan Bhu-Naksha, and the current Urban GIS ArcGIS configuration.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Public authority and viewer documentation plus current viewer configuration; no anonymous native-ID-plus-polygon parcel response, CRS metadata, or citywide geometry extent was verified.

technicalBlocker: The configured ArcGIS Khasra service and Bhu-Naksha page were unavailable by bounded anonymous requests. The accessible sources expose map/search procedures and planning layers, not a verified safe Bhiwadi parcel endpoint.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel or khasra identifier if exposed
remainingUncertainty: A Bhiwadi-specific Khasra service or a recovered Bhu-Naksha workflow may expose geometry later; current machine-readable schema, CRS and citywide extent remain unresolved.
nextStep: A serial reviewer may retry the official Bhu-Naksha/Urban GIS routes and independently qualify an adapter only after verifying a geographically scoped full polygon and stable native identity.
